messages:
Ethan: quick postmortem follow-up — we agreed to split alert work into three buckets: dedupe/grouping, threshold baselines, and paging cadence. Need owners + short timelines.
Rhea: I can take dedupe/grouping. plan: prototype group_by [service, shard], set group_interval=12m and repeat_interval=25m, and add a pre-filter to drop identical instance-origin alerts within 3m. will test on 'kv-cache' first.
Tom: I'll take thresholds/baselines. action: run a 30d baseline job, publish P95/P99 per env, set warning=P95 and page=P99 with a 2-eval-in-7m gating rule. will also add hysteresis to avoid flapping.
alert-bot: created ticket AT-5412 assigned to Rhea; AT-5413 assigned to Tom. Links: https://redwood/AT-5412, https://redwood/AT-5413
Rhea: quick example rule I'll try in staging:
```
- alert: KVCacheSpike
  expr: increase(kv_errors_total[5m]) > 5
  labels:
    severity: page
```
then rely on Alertmanager grouping/silence settings.
Tom: for baselines I'll publish a small csv and dashboard. propose we also tag scale-related events with "scale_event=true" so we can treat them as warning-only for 5m during node churn.
Ethan: paging cadence: shorten first escalation to 4m for critical services but gate escalation on dedupe+threshold pass to avoid duplicate pages. update runbook to document the warmup pattern.
pd-bot: applied 2h temporary silence to kv-cache-5xx for validation window.
Rhea: will open PR `alert/dedupe/AT-5412` tomorrow and enable in staging for 48h. will report dedupe rate and unique-alert counts.
Tom: timeline: Rhea due 2026-04-03, Tom due 2026-04-10. weekly check-in Fridays 09:30 PT.
Ethan: thanks — I'll add owners and dates to the postmortem follow-up table and create the recurring calendar invite. keep ticket comments as source of truth. :thumbsup:
